style: Soft editorial health-education illustration in blush pink, sage green and cream, modest and non-graphic, respectful, warm lighting. No text, no labels, no letters, no logos.

W01-Z.prompt: An Indian woman in her thirties in workout clothes pauses mid-exercise in a bright living room, hand on lower abdomen, thoughtful; translucent circular inset shows a simplified bladder above a supportive pelvic floor muscle band.
W01-Z.alt: Woman pausing during exercise with an inset of the bladder and pelvic floor muscles
W01-Z.caption: Leakage with coughing, sneezing or exercise (stress urinary incontinence) happens when abdominal pressure briefly exceeds bladder outlet support.

W01-Z.prompt: Translucent seated human silhouette in side view coughing, simplified internal view of a round bladder resting on a curved hammock of pelvic floor muscles between the pelvic bones, gentle downward arrows showing abdominal pressure.
W01-Z.alt: Side-view diagram of abdominal pressure from a cough pressing on the bladder and pelvic floor
W01-Z.caption: Physiology: a cough raises intra-abdominal pressure; the pelvic floor and urethral sphincter normally contract in time to keep the bladder outlet closed.
W01-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W01-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her twenties sitting on a sofa looking at a paper calendar with some dates circled at uneven intervals, phone beside her, calm and curious; translucent inset over lower abdomen shows a simplified womb and two ovaries.
W01-C.alt: Woman reviewing an uneven period calendar with an inset of the womb and ovaries
W01-C.caption: Irregular periods often reflect changes in ovulation; recording dates helps your gynaecologist see your own pattern.

W01-C.prompt: Clean textbook-style diagram of a simplified pear-shaped womb with two almond-shaped ovaries, one ovary showing a single maturing follicle with a soft glow, small circular arrows around it suggesting a monthly cycle.
W01-C.alt: Diagram of the womb and ovaries with one maturing follicle
W01-C.caption: In an ovulatory cycle, a follicle in the ovary matures and releases an egg. When ovulation is delayed or does not happen, cycle length can change.
W01-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W02-Z.prompt: A pregnant Indian woman in her second trimester walking briskly in a leafy park in comfortable clothes and trainers, water bottle in hand, relaxed smile; translucent inset shows the growing womb and baby within the abdomen.
W02-Z.alt: Pregnant woman walking in a park with an inset of the growing womb
W02-Z.caption: Moderate activity such as walking is commonly discussed in pregnancy; your maternity team confirms what suits your pregnancy.

W02-Z.prompt: Translucent standing pregnant silhouette in side view showing a simplified womb with baby, the spine with a gentle forward curve, and the pelvic floor beneath, soft arrows showing weight shifting forward.
W02-Z.alt: Side-view diagram of pregnancy posture changes with the womb, spine and pelvic floor
W02-Z.caption: As the bump grows, posture and balance change and pregnancy hormones affect connective tissue, so exercise is usually adapted rather than stopped.
W02-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W02-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her late twenties sitting with a notebook at a sunny desk, gently touching her chin, thoughtful; translucent inset shows a simplified womb with two ovaries dotted with many small round follicles.
W02-C.alt: Woman making notes with an inset of ovaries showing many small follicles
W02-C.caption: PCOS, now renamed PMOS (polyendocrine metabolic ovarian syndrome), can involve irregular ovulation, androgen-related symptoms and metabolic features. An ultrasound is only one part of assessment.

W02-C.prompt: School biology textbook diagram of a simplified womb with two almond-shaped ovaries, each ovary containing a ring of many tiny round follicles around the edge, calm educational style.
W02-C.alt: Diagram of ovaries with multiple small follicles around the edge
W02-C.caption: Polycystic ovarian morphology means many small follicles that have not developed to ovulation. Diagnosis also considers cycles, androgen signs and other possible causes.
W02-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W03-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties doing a gentle supported stretch on a yoga mat at home while her baby lies on a play mat beside her, calm and smiling; translucent inset shows simplified abdominal muscles and pelvic floor.
W03-Z.alt: New mother doing gentle exercise at home beside her baby, with an inset of core and pelvic floor muscles
W03-Z.caption: Returning to exercise after birth is gradual: pelvic floor and abdominal recovery guide progression more than a fixed date.

W03-Z.prompt: Translucent standing female silhouette front view showing simplified abdominal wall muscles as vertical bands above a supportive pelvic floor hammock, gentle upward arrows suggesting recovery and support.
W03-Z.alt: Diagram of abdominal wall muscles and pelvic floor working together after birth
W03-Z.caption: The deep abdominal muscles, diaphragm and pelvic floor work as a pressure system; postnatal rehab rebuilds their coordination before impact exercise.
W03-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W03-C.prompt: An Indian couple in their early thirties sitting together at a kitchen table with a checklist and a cup of tea, smiling and planning; translucent inset over the woman's lower abdomen shows a simplified womb and ovaries.
W03-C.alt: Couple planning pregnancy together at a kitchen table
W03-C.caption: A preconception review covers health history, medicines, vaccinations and supplements before trying to conceive.

W03-C.prompt: Clean textbook diagram of a simplified womb and two ovaries with a soft-glowing healthy womb lining, small leaf motifs around it suggesting preparation and wellbeing.
W03-C.alt: Diagram of the womb lining and ovaries prepared for pregnancy
W03-C.caption: The endometrium (womb lining) thickens each cycle to support implantation; general health before conception supports early pregnancy.
W03-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W04-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties lying on her back on a mat with knees bent, gently placing fingers along the middle of her tummy, baby nearby, calm; translucent inset shows the two vertical abdominal muscle bands slightly separated at the midline.
W04-Z.alt: New mother checking her tummy with an inset of separated abdominal muscles
W04-Z.caption: Diastasis recti is widening of the linea alba between the two rectus abdominis muscles, common after pregnancy.

W04-Z.prompt: Front-view textbook illustration of a simplified torso showing two vertical abdominal muscle bands (six-pack muscles) with a widened soft connective strip down the centre, comparison of narrow versus wider gap side by side.
W04-Z.alt: Diagram comparing a normal and widened gap between the abdominal muscles
W04-Z.caption: The linea alba is connective tissue joining the rectus abdominis; tension and function matter as much as gap width.
W04-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W04-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her late twenties sitting on her bed in the morning with a cycle-tracking notebook and a basal thermometer on the bedside table, focused; translucent inset shows an ovary releasing an egg toward the womb.
W04-C.alt: Woman tracking her cycle in the morning with an inset of ovulation
W04-C.caption: Ovulation tracking methods estimate when an egg is released; irregular cycles make estimates less certain.

W04-C.prompt: Clean textbook diagram of a simplified ovary releasing a single round egg from a mature follicle, the egg travelling along a tube toward a pear-shaped womb, soft glow at the point of release.
W04-C.alt: Diagram of an egg being released from the ovary during ovulation
W04-C.caption: At ovulation, an LH surge triggers the mature follicle to release an egg, which can be fertilised for roughly a day.
W04-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W05-Z.prompt: Two Indian women in a bright airy studio, one doing a controlled mat Pilates exercise and one on a reformer machine with springs and a sliding carriage, calm focused instructor-led atmosphere, no faces in close-up.
W05-Z.alt: Pilates studio showing a mat exercise beside a reformer machine
W05-Z.caption: STOTT Pilates is a contemporary Pilates method taught on the mat and on equipment such as the reformer.

W05-Z.prompt: Translucent female silhouette in a side-lying Pilates position showing a neutral spine, deep abdominal muscle band, diaphragm and pelvic floor highlighted in soft glow, arrows suggesting coordinated breathing.
W05-Z.alt: Diagram of neutral spine, deep core muscles and breathing during Pilates
W05-Z.caption: Pilates cues breathing, neutral spine alignment and deep core activation (transversus abdominis and pelvic floor).
W05-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W05-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her twenties looking into a bathroom mirror, lightly touching her jawline, calm and reflective, a cycle diary on the counter; translucent inset shows simplified ovaries with many small follicles.
W05-C.alt: Woman looking in a mirror and reflecting on skin changes, with an ovary inset
W05-C.caption: PCOS can present with acne, excess hair or scalp hair thinning even when periods seem regular.

W05-C.prompt: Educational diagram showing a simplified ovary on one side connected by soft arrows to icons of a hair follicle and skin pore on the other side, illustrating hormone signalling, textbook style.
W05-C.alt: Diagram linking ovarian hormones to hair and skin changes
W05-C.caption: Higher androgen levels (hyperandrogenism) from the ovaries can affect hair follicles and oil glands.
W05-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W06-Z.prompt: An Indian woman in her thirties seated upright on a chair at home with eyes closed, one hand on her belly, practising calm breathing; translucent inset shows the pelvic floor muscle band gently lifting.
W06-Z.alt: Woman seated practising pelvic floor awareness with an inset of the pelvic floor
W06-Z.caption: Kegels are pelvic floor muscle contractions; relaxing the muscles fully matters as much as squeezing.

W06-Z.prompt: Three side-by-side simplified side-view pelvis diagrams of a curved pelvic floor muscle hammock: one lifting upward, one relaxed lower, one with balanced arrows, clean textbook style.
W06-Z.alt: Three diagrams showing pelvic floor contraction, relaxation and coordination
W06-Z.caption: Pelvic floor function depends on contraction, full relaxation and timing (coordination) — not strength alone.
W06-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W06-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her twenties curled on a sofa under a light blanket holding a hot water bottle to her lower abdomen, a diary beside her; translucent inset shows a simplified womb with soft red glow of cramping.
W06-C.alt: Woman resting with a hot water bottle during period pain, with a womb inset
W06-C.caption: Period pain (dysmenorrhoea) that stops you working or studying deserves assessment.

W06-C.prompt: Textbook diagram of a simplified pear-shaped womb with its muscular wall shown contracting via small inward arrows, a soft warm glow representing prostaglandin signals.
W06-C.alt: Diagram of the womb muscle contracting during a period
W06-C.caption: Prostaglandins make the myometrium (womb muscle) contract to shed the lining, causing cramping pain.
W06-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W07-Z.prompt: A pregnant Indian woman in her third trimester sitting on a dining chair with a cushion supporting her lower back, feet flat, hand on her back, comfortable home setting; translucent inset shows the lower spine and pelvis.
W07-Z.alt: Pregnant woman sitting with lumbar support and an inset of the lower spine
W07-Z.caption: Back pain is common in pregnancy. Changing position often, pacing tasks and adjusting how you lift are reasonable things to try.

W07-Z.prompt: Translucent pregnant silhouette in side view showing the lumbar spine with an increased curve, the pelvis, and the growing womb, soft arrows showing load on the lower back.
W07-Z.alt: Side-view diagram of the lower back and pelvis during pregnancy
W07-Z.caption: Changes in posture, weight distribution and connective tissue during pregnancy can add load to the lower back and pelvis. How much each contributes varies from person to person.
W07-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W07-C.prompt: An Indian couple in their thirties holding hands while seated in a calm clinic waiting area, hopeful expressions; translucent inset over the woman shows a simplified ovary releasing an egg.
W07-C.alt: Couple waiting at a clinic with an inset of ovulation
W07-C.caption: Many people with PCOS conceive; the key conversation is about how regularly ovulation happens.

W07-C.prompt: Textbook diagram of two ovaries: one with many small paused follicles, the other with a single follicle maturing and releasing an egg toward the womb, soft glow on the released egg.
W07-C.alt: Diagram comparing paused follicles with a follicle releasing an egg
W07-C.caption: In PCOS, follicles may pause before maturing (anovulation); treatment discussions focus on supporting ovulation.
W07-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W08-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties carefully rolling onto her side to get out of bed, supporting her lower tummy with a small pillow, baby cot beside the bed, morning light; translucent inset shows a low horizontal healed line on the lower abdomen and abdominal muscle layers.
W08-Z.alt: Mother getting out of bed after a caesarean using a pillow for support
W08-Z.caption: After a caesarean birth, log-rolling and supporting the abdomen can ease everyday movements while tissues heal.

W08-Z.prompt: Simplified textbook cross-section of abdominal wall layers (skin, fat, fascia, muscle) showing a neatly healing low horizontal incision line, soft green glow suggesting healing, non-graphic.
W08-Z.alt: Diagram of abdominal wall layers healing after a caesarean section
W08-Z.caption: Simplified view of the tissue layers between the skin and the womb in a caesarean birth. Each layer heals at its own pace; your obstetric team can explain the approach used in your operation.
W08-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W08-C.prompt: An Indian couple in their early thirties sitting on a sofa looking at a calendar together, slightly concerned but supportive of each other; translucent inset shows a simplified womb and ovaries.
W08-C.alt: Couple reviewing a calendar while trying to conceive
W08-C.caption: Timing for fertility evaluation depends on age, history and symptoms; both partners may be assessed.

W08-C.prompt: Side-by-side textbook diagrams: a simplified womb with ovaries and tubes on one side and a simple sperm cell illustration on the other, joined by a soft arc, educational style.
W08-C.alt: Diagram of female reproductive organs and sperm, representing a couple's fertility assessment
W08-C.caption: Fertility assessment looks at ovulation, tubes and womb, and semen analysis for the partner.
W08-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W09-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties lying on her back on a mat with knees bent, head slightly lifted, fingers placed at her belly button, baby on a play mat beside her; translucent inset shows separated abdominal muscle bands.
W09-Z.alt: Mother doing a tummy self-check lying down, with an abdominal muscle inset
W09-Z.caption: A self-check can show how the midline feels, but it cannot diagnose diastasis recti or rule out a hernia.

W09-Z.prompt: Front-view textbook diagram of the abdominal muscles with fingers shown at the midline measuring a gap, with a small inset showing tissue tension as a taut versus soft band.
W09-Z.alt: Diagram of finger-width measurement of abdominal separation with tissue tension
W09-Z.caption: Finger-width checks give only a rough distance. How firm the midline feels and how you manage load also matter.
W09-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W09-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her late twenties at a kitchen counter holding a small supplement tablet and a glass of water, fresh vegetables and leafy greens nearby, calm morning light; translucent inset shows a simplified womb.
W09-C.alt: Woman taking a folic acid tablet with leafy greens nearby
W09-C.caption: Folic acid taken before conception and in early pregnancy lowers the risk of neural tube defects. Some people need a higher, prescribed dose.

W09-C.prompt: Gentle textbook illustration of a very early embryo curled like a small comma inside the womb, with a soft glow along its developing spine (neural tube), non-graphic.
W09-C.alt: Diagram of an early embryo with the developing neural tube
W09-C.caption: The neural tube, which becomes the brain and spinal cord, closes in the first weeks — often before pregnancy is known.
W09-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W10-Z.prompt: An Indian woman in her thirties standing tall in a bright room, hands resting on her hips, confident; translucent inset shows the bowl-shaped pelvis with the pelvic floor muscle hammock supporting the bladder and womb.
W10-Z.alt: Woman standing with an inset of the pelvic floor supporting the pelvic organs
W10-Z.caption: The pelvic floor is a group of muscles across the base of the pelvis supporting the bladder, uterus and bowel.

W10-Z.prompt: Textbook view looking down into a simplified pelvic bowl showing a hammock of layered pelvic floor muscles stretching between the pubic bone at the front and the tailbone at the back.
W10-Z.alt: Top-down diagram of the pelvic floor muscles between pubic bone and tailbone
W10-Z.caption: The levator ani muscles span from the pubic bone to the coccyx, supporting organs and controlling continence.
W10-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W10-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her thirties sitting at a desk in an office looking tired, discreetly checking her watch, a bag beside her; translucent inset shows a simplified womb with a thickened lining.
W10-C.alt: Tired woman at work with an inset of a thickened womb lining
W10-C.caption: Heavy periods (menorrhagia) can cause tiredness and affect daily life; clots and flooding warrant review.

W10-C.prompt: Textbook diagram of a simplified womb comparing a normal lining with a thicker lining and a small rounded growth within the wall, educational style.
W10-C.alt: Diagram comparing normal and thickened womb lining with a small fibroid
W10-C.caption: Causes include fibroids, polyps, adenomyosis, hormonal changes and bleeding disorders.
W10-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W11-Z.prompt: A pregnant Indian woman stepping carefully out of a car keeping her knees together, hand on her hip, calm; translucent inset shows the front of the pelvis and the pubic joint.
W11-Z.alt: Pregnant woman getting out of a car carefully with an inset of the pelvic joints
W11-Z.caption: Pelvic girdle pain often flares with asymmetric movements such as getting out of a car.

W11-Z.prompt: Front-view textbook illustration of a pelvis highlighting the joint at the front (pubic symphysis) and the two joints at the back near the spine (sacroiliac joints) with a soft glow.
W11-Z.alt: Diagram of the pelvis highlighting the pubic symphysis and sacroiliac joints
W11-Z.caption: Pelvic girdle pain involves the pubic symphysis and sacroiliac joints.
W11-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W11-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her early thirties reading a lab report on her phone in a calm clinic corridor, thoughtful; translucent inset shows a simplified ovary with small follicles.
W11-C.alt: Woman reading a blood test result with an ovary inset
W11-C.caption: AMH reflects ovarian reserve — the number of follicles — not egg quality.

W11-C.prompt: Textbook diagram of an ovary with many tiny early follicles glowing softly, with a small blood droplet icon beside it representing a hormone blood test.
W11-C.alt: Diagram of ovarian follicles producing a hormone measured in a blood test
W11-C.caption: Anti-Müllerian hormone (AMH) is made by small growing follicles and measured in blood.
W11-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W12-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties holding her baby while bending to pick up a basket of laundry, a small surprised pause; translucent inset shows the bladder and stretched pelvic floor.
W12-Z.alt: Mother lifting laundry while holding her baby, with a pelvic floor inset
W12-Z.caption: Leaking urine after childbirth is common and treatable; pelvic floor physiotherapy is a first-line option.

W12-Z.prompt: Side-by-side textbook side-view diagrams of the pelvic floor hammock: one taut and supportive, one stretched lower after birth, beneath a round bladder.
W12-Z.alt: Diagram comparing a supportive and stretched pelvic floor after childbirth
W12-Z.caption: Vaginal birth can stretch the pelvic floor muscles and nerves; most regain function with targeted rehab.
W12-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W12-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her twenties preparing a colourful balanced meal in a bright kitchen, walking shoes by the door, smiling; translucent inset shows simplified ovaries.
W12-C.alt: Woman preparing a balanced meal with an ovary inset
W12-C.caption: Daily PCOS management includes nutrition, movement, sleep and stress — chosen to fit your life.

W12-C.prompt: Educational diagram connecting a simplified ovary, a pancreas shape and a muscle icon with gentle arrows, illustrating hormone and metabolic links, clean textbook style.
W12-C.alt: Diagram linking the ovaries, pancreas and muscles in PCOS metabolism
W12-C.caption: Insulin from the pancreas and activity in muscles influence ovarian hormone production in PCOS.
W12-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W13-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties doing a gentle supported exercise with breath on a mat while her toddler plays nearby, determined calm expression; translucent inset shows abdominal muscle bands drawing toward the midline.
W13-Z.alt: Mother doing core rehab exercise with an inset of abdominal muscles closing toward the midline
W13-Z.caption: Diastasis recti often improves in the months after birth; physiotherapy guides function-based progress.

W13-Z.prompt: Front-view textbook diagram showing deep abdominal muscle wrapping horizontally like a corset beneath the two vertical abdominal bands, arrows showing gentle drawing in toward the centre.
W13-Z.alt: Diagram of the deep abdominal muscles supporting the midline
W13-Z.caption: The transversus abdominis tensions the linea alba; load management matters more than closing the gap completely.
W13-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W13-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her late twenties sitting on the edge of a bed holding a pregnancy test, hand on her chest, emotional smile; translucent inset shows a tiny early pregnancy sac in the womb.
W13-C.alt: Woman holding a positive pregnancy test with an early pregnancy inset
W13-C.caption: After a positive test, book early antenatal care and review medicines and folic acid.

W13-C.prompt: Gentle textbook illustration of a simplified womb with a tiny implanted pregnancy sac in the upper lining, soft glow, non-graphic.
W13-C.alt: Diagram of early pregnancy implanted in the womb lining
W13-C.caption: The embryo implants in the endometrium; hCG from early placenta tissue is what tests detect.
W13-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W14-Z.prompt: An Indian woman in her forties sitting on a sofa writing a short list in a notebook, calm and organised, tea beside her; translucent inset shows the pelvic floor beneath the bladder and bowel.
W14-Z.alt: Woman writing symptoms in a notebook with a pelvic floor inset
W14-Z.caption: Bladder, bowel, pain and activity symptoms together help decide if a pelvic floor assessment is needed.

W14-Z.prompt: Side-view textbook diagram of a pelvis showing the bladder at front, womb in middle and bowel at back, all resting on a curved pelvic floor muscle hammock, gentle highlights on each organ.
W14-Z.alt: Side-view diagram of the bladder, womb and bowel supported by the pelvic floor
W14-Z.caption: The pelvic floor supports three compartments: bladder (anterior), uterus (middle) and rectum (posterior).
W14-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W14-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her twenties sitting on a bed hugging a cushion to her lower abdomen, wincing slightly, a symptom diary open beside her; translucent inset shows a womb with small patches of tissue on nearby surfaces.
W14-C.alt: Woman with pelvic pain holding a cushion, with an endometriosis inset
W14-C.caption: Endometriosis is tissue similar to the womb lining growing outside the uterus, often causing painful periods.

W14-C.prompt: Textbook diagram of a simplified womb and ovaries with several small reddish patches on the outer surfaces of the ovaries and nearby pelvic lining, educational and non-graphic.
W14-C.alt: Diagram of endometriosis patches on the ovaries and pelvic lining
W14-C.caption: Endometriosis lesions can appear on the ovaries and peritoneum; scans may not show small deposits.
W14-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W15-Z.prompt: Three pregnant Indian women at different pregnancy stages (early, middle, late) doing gentle exercise side by side in a bright studio: walking on the spot, seated stretch, supported squat.
W15-Z.alt: Three pregnant women at different trimesters doing adapted exercises
W15-Z.caption: Exercise is adapted through each trimester as the body and comfort change.

W15-Z.prompt: Three translucent pregnant silhouettes in side view in a row showing a progressively growing womb and baby, with the centre of gravity marked by a soft dot moving forward.
W15-Z.alt: Diagram of the growing womb and changing posture across three trimesters
W15-Z.caption: Uterine growth, blood volume and joint laxity change through the first, second and third trimesters.
W15-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W15-C.prompt: An Indian couple in their thirties sitting together in a calm clinic consultation room looking at a simple step diagram on a tablet held by a clinician whose face is not shown, hopeful.
W15-C.alt: Couple reviewing the IVF steps on a tablet in a clinic
W15-C.caption: IVF steps include ovarian stimulation, egg retrieval, fertilisation, embryo culture and embryo transfer.

W15-C.prompt: Educational step illustration: an ovary with several follicles, a lab dish with a few round eggs, a small early embryo, and a womb receiving the embryo, connected by soft arrows, non-graphic.
W15-C.alt: Diagram of IVF steps from ovary to lab dish to embryo transfer into the womb
W15-C.caption: In vitro fertilisation joins eggs and sperm in the laboratory before transferring an embryo to the uterus.
W15-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W16-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties walking slowly with a pram in a neighbourhood park, sunlight, calm, partner beside her; translucent inset shows a womb returning to smaller size.
W16-Z.alt: Mother walking with a pram with an inset of the womb returning to size
W16-Z.caption: Postpartum recovery is gradual and individual; function and support needs guide milestones.

W16-Z.prompt: Textbook series of three simplified womb outlines shrinking in size from after birth to weeks later, with soft arrows, alongside a pelvic floor hammock regaining shape.
W16-Z.alt: Diagram of the womb shrinking after birth and the pelvic floor recovering
W16-Z.caption: Uterine involution, pelvic floor healing and abdominal wall recovery progress at different rates.
W16-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W16-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her late twenties taking an evening walk after dinner in a quiet lane, relaxed; translucent inset shows simplified ovaries and a pancreas shape.
W16-C.alt: Woman walking after a meal with an inset of ovaries and pancreas
W16-C.caption: Insulin resistance is common in PCOS and can be influenced by activity, sleep and nutrition.

W16-C.prompt: Educational diagram of a cell with small key-shaped insulin molecules approaching lock-shaped receptors on its surface, some locks partially blocked, soft colours, textbook style.
W16-C.alt: Diagram of insulin binding to cell receptors with reduced response
W16-C.caption: In insulin resistance, cells respond less to insulin, so the pancreas makes more; high insulin can raise ovarian androgens.
W16-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W17-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties doing a slow supported bridge exercise on a mat at home, breathing out, baby asleep in a bassinet nearby; translucent inset shows the deep core muscles and pelvic floor.
W17-Z.alt: Mother doing a bridge exercise with an inset of deep core muscles
W17-Z.caption: Rebuilding core strength after pregnancy starts with breathing, pelvic floor and deep abdominal coordination.

W17-Z.prompt: Translucent standing female silhouette showing the core as a cylinder: diaphragm on top, pelvic floor at the base, deep abdominal muscle wrapping the front, and spinal muscles at the back, soft glow.
W17-Z.alt: Diagram of the core cylinder: diaphragm, pelvic floor, deep abdominals and back muscles
W17-Z.caption: The core cylinder — diaphragm, pelvic floor, transversus abdominis and multifidus — manages pressure and load.
W17-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W17-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her twenties in a bathroom looking at a negative pregnancy test, calendar on the wall, puzzled but calm; translucent inset shows a womb and ovaries.
W17-C.alt: Woman checking a negative pregnancy test with a calendar nearby
W17-C.caption: A late period with a negative test may reflect testing too early, delayed ovulation or other causes.

W17-C.prompt: Simple textbook timeline illustration of a cycle wheel with ovulation marked later than usual and a period arriving later, alongside a small womb diagram.
W17-C.alt: Cycle diagram showing late ovulation delaying a period
W17-C.caption: If ovulation happens later, the period also comes later; hCG rises only after implantation.
W17-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W18-Z.prompt: An Indian woman in her forties sitting in a calm physiotherapy room talking with a physiotherapist whose face is turned away, a pelvic model on the table, relaxed; translucent inset shows the bladder and pelvic floor.
W18-Z.alt: Woman talking with a physiotherapist beside a pelvis model
W18-Z.caption: Pelvic floor muscle training supervised by a physiotherapist is a first-line treatment for stress urinary incontinence.

W18-Z.prompt: Side-view textbook diagram of the bladder and urethra with the pelvic floor hammock lifting and closing around the urethra, small arrows showing support during a cough.
W18-Z.alt: Diagram of the pelvic floor closing around the urethra to prevent leakage
W18-Z.caption: Trained pelvic floor muscles lift and close the urethra during increases in abdominal pressure.
W18-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W18-C.prompt: An Indian couple in their thirties sitting at a desk in a bright clinic comparing two simple illustrated cards, thoughtful and supportive of each other; clinician hands only visible.
W18-C.alt: Couple comparing two treatment option cards in a fertility clinic
W18-C.caption: IUI and IVF differ in where fertilisation happens and how much monitoring is involved.

W18-C.prompt: Side-by-side educational diagrams: left, a thin tube placing sperm into a womb with eggs meeting in the tube; right, eggs and sperm joined in a lab dish with an embryo then placed in the womb.
W18-C.alt: Diagram comparing IUI inside the body and IVF in the laboratory
W18-C.caption: IUI places prepared sperm in the uterus; IVF fertilises eggs in the lab before embryo transfer.

W19-Z.alt: Pregnant woman doing guided side-lying exercise in a physiotherapy studio
W19-Z.caption: Prenatal physiotherapy addresses pregnancy-related pain, pelvic floor and movement concerns.

W19-Z.prompt: Translucent pregnant silhouette side view highlighting lower spine, pelvic joints and pelvic floor in soft glow, with gentle support arrows.
W19-Z.alt: Diagram of the spine, pelvic joints and pelvic floor in pregnancy
W19-Z.caption: Prenatal physiotherapy focuses on the lumbar spine, pelvic girdle and pelvic floor as pregnancy progresses.

W19-C.prompt: A pregnant Indian woman in early pregnancy resting on a sofa sipping water, plain crackers beside her, slightly tired but calm; translucent inset shows a tiny early pregnancy in the womb.
W19-C.alt: Woman in early pregnancy resting with water and crackers
W19-C.caption: Nausea and vomiting are common in early pregnancy; inability to keep fluids down needs medical care.

W19-C.prompt: Educational diagram linking a small early placenta in the womb with soft arrows to a simplified brain and stomach, representing pregnancy hormone signals, textbook style.
W19-C.alt: Diagram of pregnancy hormones signalling the brain and stomach
W19-C.caption: Rising hCG and other hormones are linked to pregnancy nausea; severe cases (hyperemesis gravidarum) need treatment.
W19-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W20-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties breastfeeding on a supportive chair with a pillow under her baby and a cushion behind her lower back, relaxed posture; translucent inset shows the upper and lower spine.
W20-Z.alt: Mother feeding her baby with cushions supporting her back, with a spine inset
W20-Z.caption: Feeding, lifting and carrying positions can contribute to back pain after pregnancy.

W20-Z.prompt: Translucent seated silhouette side view showing the full spine with soft highlights on the upper back and lower back, arrows showing load from holding a baby.
W20-Z.alt: Diagram of spinal load while holding a baby
W20-Z.caption: Repeated forward-flexed postures load the thoracic and lumbar spine while core recovery continues.
W20-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W20-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her twenties sitting by a window with a journal, looking low and reflective, a friend's supportive hand on her shoulder; soft calendar on the wall.
W20-C.alt: Woman journaling her mood with a friend's supportive hand on her shoulder
W20-C.caption: PMDD causes severe mood symptoms in the days before a period that improve after it starts.

W20-C.prompt: Educational diagram of a simplified brain connected by soft arrows to a cycle wheel showing hormone levels rising and falling, textbook style.
W20-C.alt: Diagram linking the menstrual cycle hormone changes to the brain
W20-C.caption: PMDD is thought to involve heightened brain sensitivity to normal cyclical changes in oestrogen and progesterone.
W20-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W21-Z.prompt: Two pregnant Indian women in a bright small-group prenatal Pilates class doing a gentle seated exercise with a ball, instructor partly visible from behind, calm.
W21-Z.alt: Pregnant women in a small prenatal Pilates class using exercise balls
W21-Z.caption: Prenatal Pilates is adapted to your pregnancy; tell the instructor about pain, bleeding or pelvic symptoms.

W21-Z.prompt: Translucent pregnant silhouette seated on an exercise ball highlighting deep abdominal muscles, pelvic floor and diaphragm with soft glow, arrows showing breathing.
W21-Z.alt: Diagram of core and pelvic floor muscles during prenatal Pilates
W21-Z.caption: Prenatal Pilates focuses on breathing, pelvic floor awareness and supported core work.
W21-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W21-C.prompt: An Indian couple in their thirties arriving at a fertility clinic reception carrying a folder of reports, holding hands, calm and hopeful.
W21-C.alt: Couple arriving at a fertility clinic with their medical records
W21-C.caption: Bring cycle history, previous tests and both partners' medical history to the first fertility visit.

W21-C.prompt: Educational panel of simple icons: a womb with ovaries, a blood droplet, an ultrasound probe outline and a sperm cell, arranged in a soft circle.
W21-C.alt: Diagram of common first fertility tests: blood tests, ultrasound and semen analysis
W21-C.caption: Initial tests often include hormone blood tests, pelvic ultrasound, tubal assessment and semen analysis.

W22-Z.prompt: A pregnant Indian woman in late pregnancy sitting on a birthing ball with eyes closed breathing slowly, her partner gently supporting her shoulders, calm dim warm room.
W22-Z.alt: Pregnant woman practising labour breathing on a birthing ball with her partner
W22-Z.caption: Breathing techniques can support comfort and focus during labour alongside other pain-relief options.

W22-Z.prompt: Translucent pregnant silhouette in side view showing the diaphragm moving down on the in-breath and the pelvic floor softening, soft arrows indicating breath flow.
W22-Z.alt: Diagram of the diaphragm and pelvic floor moving with breathing in late pregnancy
W22-Z.caption: The diaphragm and pelvic floor move together; slow exhalation can help the pelvic floor relax.
W22-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W22-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her mid-thirties reading health information on a laptop at home, a cup of tea and a notebook beside her, sceptical thoughtful expression.
W22-C.alt: Woman researching egg quality information on a laptop
W22-C.caption: Egg quality depends largely on age; be cautious of products promising to improve it.

W22-C.prompt: Textbook diagram of a single egg cell with its nucleus and chromosomes shown as soft paired shapes, next to a small ovary, educational style.
W22-C.alt: Diagram of an egg cell with its chromosomes
W22-C.caption: Egg quality mainly reflects chromosomal normality, which declines with age.
W22-C.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W23-Z.prompt: An Indian woman in her thirties sitting in a private, calm consultation room listening to a physiotherapist whose face is turned away, a box of tissues and a pelvis model on the desk, respectful atmosphere.
W23-Z.alt: Woman in a private consultation talking with a physiotherapist
W23-Z.caption: Painful sex (dyspareunia) deserves a respectful assessment; examination happens only with your consent.

W23-Z.prompt: Side-view textbook diagram of the pelvic floor muscle hammock shown tense and shortened on one side and relaxed on the other, beneath the pelvic organs.
W23-Z.alt: Diagram comparing tense and relaxed pelvic floor muscles
W23-Z.caption: Overactive (high-tone) pelvic floor muscles are one possible contributor to pain; medical causes are checked too.

W23-C.prompt: A woman in early pregnancy sitting on a sofa holding her phone to her ear calling for medical advice, one hand on her lower abdomen, concerned but composed, overnight bag beside her.
W23-C.alt: Pregnant woman phoning for medical advice with her hand on her abdomen
W23-C.caption: Bleeding in early pregnancy should be discussed promptly; heavy bleeding or severe pain needs urgent care.

W23-C.prompt: Gentle textbook diagram of a simplified womb with an early pregnancy sac inside, and a separate small outline of a tube with a soft caution glow, non-graphic.
W23-C.alt: Diagram of an early pregnancy in the womb and a tube outline representing ectopic risk
W23-C.caption: Causes range from implantation bleeding to miscarriage or ectopic pregnancy, which needs urgent assessment.

W24-Z.prompt: An Indian mother in her thirties in a bright postnatal Pilates class doing a gentle supine exercise, her baby lying on a mat next to her, calm supportive atmosphere.
W24-Z.alt: Mother in a postnatal Pilates class with her baby beside her
W24-Z.caption: Postnatal Pilates is started after checking pelvic floor and abdominal recovery.

W24-Z.prompt: Translucent supine female silhouette with knees bent showing deep abdominal muscles and pelvic floor highlighted, soft arrows showing gentle activation.
W24-Z.alt: Diagram of deep abdominals and pelvic floor in a postnatal Pilates position
W24-Z.caption: Early postnatal Pilates targets transversus abdominis and pelvic floor coordination before load increases.
W24-Z.approvalNote: Owner confirmed on 18 Nov 2026 that the doctors approved this diagram.

W24-C.prompt: An Indian couple in their thirties sitting close on a sofa, the woman resting her head on her partner's shoulder, a folder of medical papers on the table, quiet and supportive.
W24-C.alt: Couple comforting each other after an IVF cycle
W24-C.caption: After an unsuccessful IVF cycle, a review appointment can go through what happened and options.

W24-C.alt: Diagram of an embryo and the womb lining at implantation
W24-C.caption: Implantation depends on the embryo and the endometrium; many factors cannot be predicted in advance.

W25-Z.prompt: An Indian woman in her fifties standing in her kitchen pausing with a hand on her lower abdomen, calm and thoughtful; translucent inset shows pelvic organs sitting lower than usual on the pelvic floor.
W25-Z.alt: Woman in her kitchen with an inset of pelvic organs sitting lower
W25-Z.caption: A feeling of heaviness or a bulge can be pelvic organ prolapse; assessment guides options.

W25-Z.prompt: Side-by-side side-view textbook diagrams of the pelvis: one with bladder and womb well supported by the pelvic floor hammock, one with the organs sitting lower and the hammock stretched.
W25-Z.alt: Diagram comparing supported pelvic organs and pelvic organ prolapse
W25-Z.caption: Prolapse occurs when pelvic floor and connective tissue support weakens and organs descend.

W25-C.prompt: An Indian woman in her mid-forties fanning herself at a desk during a warm flush, a water glass and symptom diary nearby, calm and composed.
W25-C.alt: Woman in her forties experiencing a hot flush at her desk
W25-C.caption: Perimenopause can bring cycle changes, hot flushes, sleep and mood changes.

W25-C.prompt: Educational diagram of an ovary with fewer follicles linked by a soft wavy line showing fluctuating hormone levels, beside a small brain icon, textbook style.
W25-C.alt: Diagram of ovarian follicles declining with fluctuating hormone levels
W25-C.caption: In perimenopause, oestrogen fluctuates as follicles decline, before periods stop at menopause.

W26-Z.alt: Woman at her first pelvic health physiotherapy appointment
W26-Z.caption: A first pelvic health appointment starts with your history and goals; examination is always optional and consented.

W26-Z.caption: Physiotherapists often use a pelvis model to explain pelvic floor anatomy before any assessment.

W26-C.caption: HRT decisions weigh symptoms, personal risks and preferences with your doctor.

W26-C.alt: Diagram of oestrogen effects on brain, bones and heart
W26-C.caption: Oestrogen affects temperature regulation, bone density, the urogenital tissues and more.
